strings.cli.gmmGtaVMiniMod:
gmm — GTA V mini mod manager (Legacy / Enhanced)

  gmm info     <game folder>
  gmm oiv      <package.oiv> <game folder> [--dry-run]     install OIV (dry-run — plan only)
  gmm mod      <zip|rar|7z archive> <game folder> [--dry-run]  install a regular mod (add-on DLC, ASI, scripts)
  gmm pack-add <game folder> <archive> <internal path> <files...>
               add/replace files in a DLC pack, for example:
               gmm pack-add "D:\Games\GTA V Enhanced" update\x64\dlcpacks\mycar\dlc.rpf x64\vehicles.rpf car.yft car.ytd
  gmm history  <game folder>                         package operation history
  gmm undo     <game folder> <id>                    undo a package operation
  gmm keybinds <game folder>                         mod hotkeys from their configs
  gmm keybind-set <game folder> <id> <shortcut|none> change a hotkey (none — disable)
  gmm mods-status <game folder>                      mod toggle status
  gmm mods-disable <game folder>                     disable loaders by renaming to .gmm-off
  gmm mods-enable <game folder>                      restore original loader names
  gmm peds-install <game folder> <archive> <selections.json>  selected Add-On PEDs (Legacy only)
  gmm peds-install-batch <game folder> <requests.json>  archive queue, separate transaction per archive
  gmm peds-remove <game folder> <spawn>              remove a managed PED
  gmm peds-remove-many <game folder> <names.json>    remove selected managed PEDs in one transaction
  gmm peds-sync <game folder>                        update the managed selector list
  gmm peds-selector-install <game folder> <asi>      install the managed native selector
  gmm peds-selector-remove <game folder>             remove the managed selector
  gmm base-status <game folder>                      modding essentials: installed components
  gmm vanilla-restore <game folder> [--delete]  remove all mods and their traces (Rockstar originals are untouched)
  gmm starter-install <game folder> <manifest.json>  full starter package (one UAC approval)
  gmm base-install <game folder> [--shv <zip>] [--rageopenv <asi>] [--shvdn nightly|enhanced <zip>]
               Backups are required for peds commands.
  gmm backup-setup <folder> <limit>                  enable backups, for example: gmm backup-setup D:\GTA_Backups 50GB
  gmm backup-off                                    install without backups (undo will be unavailable)
  gmm backup-info                                   folder, limit and used space
